Kohl, 1,458 yards, 7 TDs, 7 INTs, 58.3 completion percentage Rushing: Devonte Lyons, 268 yards on 65 carries, 1 TD Receiving: Maguire Anderson, 535 yards on 33 catches, 4 TDs Middle Tennessee Passing: Roman Gagliano, 1,204 yards, 11 TDs, 2 INTs, 58.5 completion percentage Rushing: Antonio Martin, 433 yards on 83 carries, 1 TD Receiving: Cam'ron Lacy, 369 yards on 35 catches, 4 TDs Last game Florida International fell 27-24 to Jacksonville State on Oct. 13.
